archetypes.name: dyn-hook-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Activation semantics span hook code, skill prose, and cleanup paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the deny-edit-write activation lifecycle across the hook and both skill consumers. Focus on whether stale, tokenless, cross-token, and cleanup failure cases preserve the intended fail-open versus active fail-closed split. Check that /bug remains guarded while /research leaks stay inactive. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
